title: Nonna's Spinach & Ricotta Cannelloni
subtitle: with Mozzarella & Parmesan Cheese
description: Sink into pure comfort with these melt-in-your-mouth pasta tubes packed with creamy ricotta and earthy spinach. Baked in a rich tomato sauce and smothered with a bubbly, golden duo of melted mozzarella and sharp Parmesan, it's a cheesy, Italian-inspired dream. Treat yourself to a truly decadent, restaurant-quality bake right at home.

steps.text:
• Preheat oven to 220°C/200°C fan-forced.
• Thinly slice brown onion.

• Heat a large frying pan over medium-high heat with a drizzle of olive oil.
• Cook onion, stirring, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
• Add baby spinach leaves and cook until just wilted, 1-2 minutes. Transfer to a large bowl and set aside to cool slightly, 5 minutes.
• Once the filling has cooled, add ricotta and Parmesan cheese, then season with salt and pepper. Gently mix until combined.

• Slice lasagne sheets in half widthways. Spoon a quarter of the diced tomatoes with garlic & onion into the bottom of a baking dish.
• Lay cut lasagne sheet halves on a flat surface.
• Spoon a heaped tablespoon of spinach-ricotta filling down the centre of each sheet. Roll sheets up tightly and place, seamside down, in the baking dish.
• Repeat with remaining sheets and filling, ensuring they fit together snuggly in the baking dish.
• Evenly spread cannelloni with the remaining diced tomatoes and sprinkle with grated mozzarella. Bake until golden, 15-20 minutes.

• Divide spinach and ricotta cannelloni between plates.
• Garnish with a pinch of chilli flakes (if using) to serve. Enjoy!
